name: British American Tobacco Kenya Plc
source: British American Tobacco Kenya plc audited results for the year ended 31 December 2025 | kenyanstocks.com financial statements API, farmed harvest. Profit Before Tax derived as Net Profit plus Income Tax; Gross Profit as Revenue minus Cost of Sales. Cross checked: Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit and Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. Filled 2026-10-01 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API: Income Tax FY2024 from the source line Income Tax. | Gap fill 2026-10-01 from the issuer audited results: British American Tobacco Kenya plc, AUDITED RESULTS FOR THE YEAR ENDED 31 DECEMBER 2025, condensed statement of profit or loss, KShs millions (source: https://www.batkenya.com/content/dam/endmarkets/ke/en/download/investors-and-reporting/financial-statements/bat_kenya-2025_full_year_results.pdf). Printed lines: Profit before tax 7,671; Income tax expense (2,425); Profit after tax 5,246; Basic and diluted earnings per share 52.46. The stored EPS cell held 52,460,000, which is 52.46 multiplied by 1,000,000, and is corrected to 52.46 to match the FY2024 cell of 44.83 and the printed statement. Income Tax 2,425,000,000 and EPS 52.46 tie to the printed statement: 7,671 - 2,425 = 5,246.
source_note: KShs millions x 1,000,000 to absolute KES. Condensed audited statement; OCI is nil so total comprehensive income equals profit after tax. H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-bat-2026-ir-hy/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled.
